transcript.text: Hi, I was charged twice for my subscription this month and I'm honestly pretty frustrated, this is the second time this has happened.

I'm sorry that happened again, especially after last time -- that's frustrating and I want to get this fixed properly. Can you confirm the last 4 digits of the card and the date(s) you see the charges?
Card ending 4482, charges on the 3rd and the 5th.

Thanks. I can see both charges -- the one on the 5th was a duplicate caused by a billing retry error on our end, not something you did. I've refunded that charge; it should post back to your card within 3-5 business days. I've also flagged your account so our billing team checks it manually next cycle to make sure it doesn't happen a third time.
Okay, thank you. Will I get a confirmation email?
Yes, you'll get a refund confirmation within the next few minutes, and a separate note once billing confirms the account flag is in place. Is there anything else I can help with?

resolution.evidence: Duplicate charge identified, refunded, and a preventive flag added -- customer confirms no further needs.

accuracy.evidence: Explanation of the billing retry error is specific and consistent with the refund action taken; no contradictions.

empathy_tone.evidence: Agent explicitly acknowledges this is a repeat issue and the frustration it causes before moving to verification.

policy_adherence.evidence: Verified identity (last 4 digits + dates) before discussing account/billing details.

clarity.evidence: Refund timeline and next steps (two separate confirmation emails) are stated explicitly.

efficiency.evidence: Resolved in a small number of turns; one follow-up question from customer about confirmation email, which is reasonable and not redundant.

gold_scores.summary: Agent verified identity, correctly diagnosed a recurring billing error, resolved it with a refund and a preventive account flag, and communicated next steps clearly and empathetically.
